what: Quota pools, endpoints, upstream-congestion profiles and routing plans for tools/quota-sim.
status: Research data, not a decision. No model was run and no keyed API was called to compile it.
tags: [V] verified at the cited source on the given date; [V-obs] Plotroom's own run records (not in the repository); [V-3p] third-party figure; [I] our inference or arithmetic; [U] unknown placeholder.
scope_rule: Every cloud pool is one account on the user's own sign-in, one account per provider (doc 50 section 1.3; D008). No Plotroom-owned key, proxy or shared account appears anywhere. Every cloud endpoint is unqualified (doc 50 section 5.1; D044): the step-kind readings below are screening plausibility ('plausible'), standing in for a qualification the simulator cannot make.
day_assumption: A simulated day starts after 00:00 UTC and ends before the next reset; the user spent no quota earlier that UTC day, and none of the month's Hugging Face credits. [I]

observed.tag: [V-obs] calibrated to the one observed window (2026-09-27 20:17-20:35 UTC, qwen3.8-27b:free): 12 of 13 attempts (0.92) were upstream 429s and the throttling outlasted 15 min; a stationary congested share of 1200 / 1290 = 0.93 gives an attempt failure share of 0.93 x 0.97 + 0.07 x 0.05 = 0.91 (unit-tested). Episode and gap lengths [I]; one window only [U] for other hours and hosts.

moderate.tag: [U] placeholder: the host is congested a quarter of the time, in 10-minute episodes

low.tag: [U] placeholder for dedicated free capacity (Groq, Cloudflare, the HF router): never called by Plotroom

paid.tag: [U] placeholder for a paid pinned endpoint. It matches 9 of the 11 paid pinned hosts screened on 2026-09-27 (22:18-23:30 UTC; 3 upstream 429s in 2,296 attempts) and is optimistic for the other 2, which refused 23% and 32% of their attempts for 7-10 minutes [V-obs].

congestion_levels.note: A scenario's level maps each endpoint's congestion class to a profile. 'observed' applies the one measured window to OpenRouter :free hosts only, because only they were measured; 'stress' also throttles every other free host [U] to test what S5 and S6 add.

routing_plans.note: Preference order per step kind [I]: strict-schema and ZDR endpoints first for Pick and Fill, the largest plausible writers first for text. Only 'plausible' or 'measured-pass' entries may appear, and no endpoint with 'excluded_by' (unit tests check both). Content-policy bands (D047) are not modelled: filtering them first can only shrink these lists.
